summary: Global Mofy AI filed a 6-K disclosing an August 19, 2026 Share Exchange and Investment Agreement under which it issues 1,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$2.70 per share, aggregate US$4,050,000, to James Yang Mofy Limited in exchange for a 5.06% equity interest in Qifei (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd., transferred to indirect subsidiary Shanghai Moying Feihuan. CEO Haogang Yang controls both seller and target, making it a related-party transaction; the Audit Committee found terms no less favorable than arm's-length. Closing conditions include PRC regulatory filings, due diligence, and consents; resale registration on Form F-1/F-3 is required within two months. Watch PRC approval timing, related-party governance scrutiny, and potential share overhang.
